title: Lidostā (At the airport)
summary: Two travellers help each other navigate Riga International airport — finding the gate and the cafe.

roles.name: Ceļotājs A
roles.label: Arriving passenger
roles.objective: Ask for help finding the bus to the city centre and a place to eat.
starter_lines: Atvainojiet, vai jūs varat man palīdzēt?
Kur ir autobusa pietura uz centru?

roles.name: Ceļotājs B
roles.label: Departing passenger
roles.objective: Help with directions, ask about flight delays, and check your gate together.
starter_lines: Autobuss numur 22 brauc uz centru, pietura ir ārā.
Vai jūs zināt, kur ir A izeja?

objectives_shared: Find one shared location (gate or cafe).
Wish each other a good trip at the end.
safety_rules: Never share passport, flight, or seat numbers — keep it generic.
Stay polite. Use 'Jūs' to a stranger you just met.
